messages.author: 3edc58ee737edd94
messages.subject: Re: [StatForLing with R] Interpreting "validate.lrm"
parts:
See Baayen (2008:194):

index.orig= values from the non-bootstrapped regression
training= average values from bootstrapped samples
test= average values when bootstrapped models are applied to full data
optimism= training-test
index.corrected=index.orig-optimism
n: number of bootstrap samples

STG
